cases.name: closure-state
cases.description: The design uses environment identity deliberately and gives each factory call independent state.
cases.prompt: Write an R counter factory. Two counters must not share state, while repeated calls to one counter should update its private count.
traps: Stores state in the global environment
Creates one shared mutable environment outside the factory

assertions.text: Creates private state inside each factory invocation.
Explains that the returned function retains its enclosing environment.
Tests independence across factory calls and persistence within one closure.

cases.name: namespace-versus-search-path
cases.description: The explanation distinguishes package attachment from namespace lookup and avoids accidental global writes.
cases.prompt: A package function works only after the user calls library() and a helper using <<- creates a global binding unexpectedly. Diagnose both issues.
traps: Treats the attached package environment as the function's lexical environment
Accepts <<- fallback to the global environment as harmless

assertions.text: Distinguishes package attachment from namespace imports and lexical lookup.
Explains the ancestor search and global fallback behavior of <<-.
Recommends explicit bindings or controlled ancestor updates.
